text: Implemented data-derived PrincipalComponents LatentSketch slice. LatentSketchMethod now includes explicit PrincipalComponents with fixed-rank validation; the fit backend now represents identity, contiguous averaging, and PCA as loading bases prepared once on the full selected response. PCA sketches project through shared linalg SVD, decode coefficients/covariance per voxel, and remain scheduler-neutral across Future voxel chunks. Added model validation tests, rank-one PCA-vs-OLS coefficient recovery, and chunked PCA reuse coverage. Evidence: final sbt modelJVM/test modelJS/test fitJVM/test fitJS/test passed 16/16/123/118; scoped git diff --check clean. Remaining: reduced-rank GLS covariance/inference bundles and fmrireg lowrank/rrr fixture parity.
